open_area_min_mm2.how: A = Q / (Cd sqrt(2 g h)) = 78.0 cm³/s / (0.61 x 313 mm/s)

hole_min_mm.how: water holds a film under 2.71 mm (sqrt(sigma / rho g)); full flow from 4.0 mm

hole_max_mm.how: hard cap; smaller is better capture

plate_t_min_mm.how: stiffness t >= 1.23 (clamped plate, D x solid²); strength t >= 1.94 at 30 N, 20 MPa allowable

checks: At the 2.2 mm plate and 51% open: fingertip deflection 0.088 mm (limit 0.5), hard-push rib stress 15.5 MPa (allowable 20). Structure is close: 1.29x on the tighter of the two, so the plate stays at 2.2 mm (minimum 1.94).
Drainage binds: 408 mm² of open area is 51% of the bore.
A flat plate with 1.5 mm ribs reaches that with holes of about 5.3 mm inscribed (hexagonal estimate, ±15%). A 47.0° cone has 1.47x the area, so holes can drop to the 4.0 mm floor.

concepts.name: flat plate
concepts.why: Prints top-down with nothing over air and sits flush. Meets the flow target with ~5.3 mm holes; drainage is the active constraint, so the search should spend its freedom on open area, not thickness.

concepts.name: cone
concepts.why: 1.47x the grate area: holes down to the 4.0 mm floor for the same flow. Costs ~18 mm of insert depth and runs the underside at the 45° overhang limit. Use it if the owner wants holes under the flat-plate size.

concepts.name: two-level
concepts.why: The fine layer catches more hair but lowers flow, and it bridges (pebble-c: ~189 mm² over air) or needs vaults (pebble-d). Not needed while the flow target is met by one layer.

open_questions: No tap flow was given. The flow target is smooth v2's 78 cm³/s under the same orifice model; a measured tap rate should replace it (function.drain_flow_min_cm3_s).
No largest acceptable hole was given beyond the 12 mm cap. Capture is maximized, not bounded.
allowable_MPa 20 is a layer-line PLA guess, not a test.
